# Partner Workshop Content Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** In DEV only, hide Deployed rows from the partner report and append an auto-generated, compliance-safe, per-use-case workshop (Session 1 starter prompts + Session 2 recipe match and implementation plan) to the HTML and PDF.

**Architecture:** New package `utils/workshop/` (gate, context fetch, prompts, generator, cache, compliance scrub, HTML/PDF renderers) with bundled assets (cookbook recipes, verbatim skill files + override). The page calls `generate_workshops()` after the existing judge pipeline when `get_env()=="dev"`, then passes results to the existing builders via a new optional `workshops` parameter.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.11, Streamlit in Snowflake (container runtime), Cortex REST `claude-sonnet-4-5` via `utils.cortex_rest_helpers.cortex_complete_rest`, reportlab, pytest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-partner-workshop-content-design.md`

```python
import pandas as pd


class FakeConn:
    """Mimics st.connection('snowflake') .query(sql, ttl=...) for unit tests."""

    def __init__(self, responses=None):
        self.responses = responses or {}
        self.queries = []

    def query(self, sql, ttl=None):
        self.queries.append(sql)
        for needle, df in self.responses.items():
            if needle in sql:
                return df
        return pd.DataFrame()
```

```python
"""Deterministic compliance helpers for partner-facing workshop text.

Rules follow the Alliances Data Sharing deck: no contract/consumption numbers,
no internal list/gate terminology, no links outside the bundled allowlist.
"""
import re

_SUFFIXES = {"inc", "incorporated", "corp", "corporation", "llc", "ltd", "limited",
             "plc", "ag", "gmbh", "co", "company", "sa", "nv", "bv", "lp", "llp"}

_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"[$€£]\s?\d[\d,.]*\s?(?:k|m|mm|b|bn)?\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b\d[\d,.]*\s?(?:k|m|mm|bn)?\s?(?:usd|dollars)\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b\d[\d,.]*\s*(?:ai\s+)?credits?\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b(?:eacv|tcv|acv|arr|run[- ]rate)\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b(?:red|green)[ -]?(?:light|list)\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\btop[_ ]snowflake[_ ]companies\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b(?:restricted account|not on the list|no (?:usage|a360|account) data"
               r"|data (?:is )?not available|limited data)\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\bstage\s*[1-7]\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b(?:health|churn|meddpicc)\s*score\b", re.I),
]
_URL = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s)\"'<>]+")
_SENT_SPLIT = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+")


def normalize_company(name: str) -> str:
    s = (name or "").lower().replace("&", " and ")
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s).split()
    if s and s[0] == "the":
        s = s[1:]
    while s and s[-1] in _SUFFIXES:
        s = s[:-1]
    return " ".join(s)


def find_violations(text: str) -> list:
    hits = []
    for p in _PATTERNS:
        hits.extend(m.group(0) for m in p.finditer(text or ""))
    return hits


def scrub(text: str, allowed_links: set) -> str:
    def _link(m):
        url = m.group(0).rstrip(".,;")
        return m.group(0) if url in allowed_links else ""
    text = _URL.sub(_link, text or "")
    kept = [s for s in _SENT_SPLIT.split(text) if not find_violations(s)]
    return re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", " ".join(kept)).strip()
```

```python
"""Regenerate utils/workshop/assets from the AI cookbook and the two source skills.

Usage: uv run --with pyyaml python scripts/bundle_workshop_assets.py
"""
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "utils" / "workshop" / "assets"
COOKBOOK = Path(os.environ.get("COOKBOOK_DIR", "/Users/plakhanpal/Documents/git/cortex-ai-cookbook/recipes"))
ACTIVATION = Path(os.environ.get("ACTIVATION_SKILL_DIR",
                  "/Users/plakhanpal/Documents/git/cortexcode/coco-customer-activation-planner"))
IMPL_GLOB = os.path.expanduser(
    "~/.snowflake/cortex/stage_cache/*/skills/pse-uc-implementation-plan")
URL_RE = re.compile(r"https://(?:docs|quickstarts|www|developers)\.snowflake\.com[^\s)\"'<>`]*")


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    if OUT.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(OUT)
    (OUT / "recipes").mkdir(parents=True)
    (OUT / "skills").mkdir()
    versions, index, links = {}, [], set()

    for yml in sorted(COOKBOOK.glob("*/*/recipe.yaml")):
        meta = yaml.safe_load(yml.read_text())
        rid = f"{yml.parent.parent.name}/{yml.parent.name}"
        readme = yml.parent / "README.md"
        body = readme.read_text() if readme.exists() else ""
        sql_files = sorted(p.name for p in (yml.parent / "sql").glob("*.sql")) if (yml.parent / "sql").exists() else []
        (OUT / "recipes" / (rid.replace("/", "__") + ".md")).write_text(body)
        index.append({"id": rid, "title": meta.get("title", ""), "description": meta.get("description", ""),
                      "topics": meta.get("topics", []), "features": meta.get("features", []),
                      "stages": meta.get("stages", []), "estimated_time": meta.get("estimated_time", ""),
                      "sql_files": sql_files,
                      "related_skills": [s.get("name") for s in meta.get("related_skills", []) or []]})
        links.update(u.rstrip(".,") for u in URL_RE.findall(body))
        versions[f"recipe:{rid}"] = sha(yml) + ":" + (sha(readme) if readme.exists() else "")

    impl_dirs = sorted(glob.glob(IMPL_GLOB), key=os.path.getmtime)
    if not impl_dirs:
        raise SystemExit("pse-uc-implementation-plan not found in stage cache")
    impl = Path(impl_dirs[-1])
    for name, src in [("coco-customer-activation-planner/SKILL.md", ACTIVATION / "SKILL.md"),
                      ("pse-uc-implementation-plan/SKILL.md", impl / "SKILL.md"),
                      ("pse-uc-implementation-plan/templates/report_template.html",
                       impl / "templates" / "report_template.html")]:
        dst = OUT / "skills" / name
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
        versions[f"skill:{name}"] = sha(src)
        links.update(u.rstrip(".,") for u in URL_RE.findall(src.read_text()))

    (OUT / "recipes_index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=1))
    (OUT / "link_allowlist.json").write_text(json.dumps(sorted(links), indent=1))
    (OUT / "skills" / "VERSIONS.json").write_text(json.dumps(versions, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
    print(f"recipes={len(index)} links={len(links)} skills=3")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement** `utils/workshop/assets.py`:

```python
import functools
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
_ASSETS = _DIR / "assets"


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def recipes_index() -> list:
    return json.loads((_ASSETS / "recipes_index.json").read_text())


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def recipe_body(recipe_id: str) -> str:
    p = _ASSETS / "recipes" / (recipe_id.replace("/", "__") + ".md")
    return p.read_text() if p.exists() else ""


def recipe_meta(recipe_id: str) -> dict:
    return next((r for r in recipes_index() if r["id"] == recipe_id), {})


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def skill_text(rel_path: str) -> str:
    return (_ASSETS / "skills" / rel_path).read_text()


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def override_text() -> str:
    return (_DIR / "skill_override.md").read_text()


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def link_allowlist() -> frozenset:
    return frozenset(json.loads((_ASSETS / "link_allowlist.json").read_text()))


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def asset_version() -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256((_ASSETS / "skills" / "VERSIONS.json").read_bytes())
    h.update(override_text().encode())
    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `utils/workshop/gate.py`:

```python
"""Internal account eligibility + policy-safe A360 signals. Never rendered."""
from .compliance import normalize_company

LISTED_SQL = "SELECT COMPANY_NAME FROM SNOWHOUSE.IT.RAW_GOOGLE_SHEETS.TOP_SNOWFLAKE_COMPANIES"
BIG_TIER_MIN_ACTIVE_USERS = 25


def load_listed_names(conn) -> frozenset:
    df = conn.query(LISTED_SQL, ttl=3600)
    names = df["COMPANY_NAME"].tolist() if "COMPANY_NAME" in df.columns else []
    return frozenset(n for n in (normalize_company(x) for x in names) if n)


def is_listed(account: str, listed: frozenset) -> bool:
    n = normalize_company(account)
    return bool(n) and n in listed


def usage_tier(active_users) -> str:
    n = int(active_users or 0)
    if n >= BIG_TIER_MIN_ACTIVE_USERS:
        return "Big"
    return "Low" if n > 0 else "No"


def _in_list(accounts) -> str:
    return ", ".join("'" + a.upper().replace("'", "''") + "'" for a in sorted(set(accounts)) if a)


def fetch_a360_context(conn, accounts: list) -> dict:
    """{ACCOUNT_UPPER: {usage_tier, surfaces, enablement_needed, dominant_maturity}} — tiers/flags only."""
    in_list = _in_list(accounts)
    if not in_list:
        return {}
    usage = conn.query(f"""
        SELECT UPPER(SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NAME) AS ACCOUNT_UPPER,
               SUM(ACTIVE_USERS) AS ACTIVE_USERS, SUM(ANY_UI_USERS) AS ANY_UI_USERS,
               SUM(ANY_CLI_DESKTOP_USERS) AS ANY_CLI_DESKTOP_USERS,
               BOOLOR_AGG(IS_COCO_BLOCKED) AS IS_COCO_BLOCKED
        FROM SALES.REPORTING.COCO_ACCOUNT_COCO_USAGE
        WHERE IS_YESTERDAY AND UPPER(SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NAME) IN ({in_list})
        GROUP BY 1""", ttl=3600)
    maturity = conn.query(f"""
        SELECT ACCOUNT_UPPER, USER_MATURITY FROM (
          SELECT UPPER(SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NAME) AS ACCOUNT_UPPER, USER_MATURITY,
                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NAME) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RN
          FROM SALES.REPORTING.COCO_USER_MATURITY_SNAPSHOT
          WHERE DS = (SELECT MAX(DS) FROM SALES.REPORTING.COCO_USER_MATURITY_SNAPSHOT)
            AND UPPER(SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NAME) IN ({in_list}) AND USER_MATURITY IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY 1, 2) WHERE RN = 1""", ttl=3600)
    mat = dict(zip(maturity.get("ACCOUNT_UPPER", []), maturity.get("USER_MATURITY", [])))
    out = {}
    for _, r in usage.iterrows():
        surfaces = (["Snowsight"] if (r["ANY_UI_USERS"] or 0) > 0 else []) + \
                   (["CLI/Desktop"] if (r["ANY_CLI_DESKTOP_USERS"] or 0) > 0 else [])
        out[r["ACCOUNT_UPPER"]] = {"usage_tier": usage_tier(r["ACTIVE_USERS"]), "surfaces": surfaces,
                                   "enablement_needed": bool(r["IS_COCO_BLOCKED"]),
                                   "dominant_maturity": mat.get(r["ACCOUNT_UPPER"], "")}
    return out
```

```python
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_PROOF_OF_CONCEPT_LED_BY AS POC_LED_BY, u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_PROOF_OF_CONCEPT_STAGE AS POC_STAGE,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_IMPLEMENTER AS IMPLEMENTER, u.IS_SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_MISSION_CRITICAL AS MISSION_CRITICAL,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES_ENGAGEMENT AS PS_ENGAGEMENT,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_CLOUD_PROVIDER AS CLOUD_PROVIDER, u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_CLOUD_REGION AS CLOUD_REGION,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_LINE_OF_BUSINESS AS LINE_OF_BUSINESS,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_RISK_DESCRIPTION AS RISK_DESCRIPTION,
  u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_FUTURE_STATE_ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM AS FUTURE_STATE_DIAGRAM,
  a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_INDUSTRY AS INDUSTRY, a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_SUBINDUSTRY AS SUB_INDUSTRY,
  a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_BILLING_COUNTRY AS BILLING_COUNTRY, a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_BILLING_STATE AS BILLING_STATE,
  a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_WEBSITE AS WEBSITE, a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_OF_EMPLOYEES AS EMPLOYEES,
  a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT AS SEGMENT
FROM SNOW_CERTIFIED.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE.DD_SALESFORCE_USE_CASE u
LEFT JOIN SNOW_CERTIFIED.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT.DD_SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT a
  ON a.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_ID = u.SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_ID
WHERE u.SALESFORCE_USE_CASE_ID IN ({ids})
"""


def fetch_uc_context(conn, uc_ids: list) -> dict:
    safe = [i for i in uc_ids if i and _ID_RE.match(i)]
    if not safe:
        return {}
    df = conn.query(UC_CONTEXT_SQL.format(ids=", ".join(f"'{i}'" for i in safe)), ttl=3600)
    out = {}
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        d = {}
        for k, v in r.items():
            if k in NEVER_SENT or k == "USE_CASE_ID" or v is None or str(v).strip() in ("", "nan", "None"):
                continue
            d[k] = "named champion identified" if k in PEOPLE else str(v)
        out[r["USE_CASE_ID"]] = d
    return out
```

```python
import hashlib
import json

from utils.config import get_schema


def _t(name):
    return f"{get_schema()}.{name}"


def ensure_tables(conn):
    conn.query(f"""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {_t('COCO_PSE_WORKSHOP_CACHE')} (
        CACHE_KEY_HASH STRING, ASSET_VERSION STRING, PARTNER_NAME STRING, USE_CASE_ID STRING,
        PAYLOAD VARIANT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP_LTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())""", ttl=0)
    conn.query(f"""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {_t('WORKSHOP_GENERATION_AUDIT')} (
        PARTNER_NAME STRING, USE_CASE_ID STRING, PATH STRING, CACHE_HIT BOOLEAN,
        GENERATED_AT TIMESTAMP_LTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())""", ttl=0)


def compute_hash(inputs: dict, asset_version: str) -> str:
    blob = json.dumps(inputs, sort_keys=True, default=str) + "\x1f" + asset_version
    return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()


def _q(s):
    return (s or "").replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "''")


def lookup(conn, hashes: list) -> dict:
    if not hashes:
        return {}
    df = conn.query(f"""SELECT CACHE_KEY_HASH, PAYLOAD FROM {_t('COCO_PSE_WORKSHOP_CACHE')}
        WHERE CACHE_KEY_HASH IN ({', '.join(f"'{h}'" for h in hashes)})""", ttl=0)
    out = {}
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        p = r["PAYLOAD"]
        out[r["CACHE_KEY_HASH"]] = json.loads(p) if isinstance(p, str) else p
    return out


def insert(conn, rows: list, asset_version: str = ""):
    """rows: (hash, partner, uc_id, payload_dict)."""
    if not rows:
        return
    sel = " UNION ALL ".join(
        f"SELECT '{h}', '{_q(asset_version)}', '{_q(p)}', '{_q(u)}', PARSE_JSON('{_q(json.dumps(pl))}')"
        for h, p, u, pl in rows)
    conn.query(f"""INSERT INTO {_t('COCO_PSE_WORKSHOP_CACHE')}
        (CACHE_KEY_HASH, ASSET_VERSION, PARTNER_NAME, USE_CASE_ID, PAYLOAD) {sel}""", ttl=0)


def audit(conn, rows: list):
    """rows: (partner, uc_id, path, cache_hit)."""
    if not rows:
        return
    sel = " UNION ALL ".join(f"SELECT '{_q(p)}', '{_q(u)}', '{_q(path)}', {str(bool(hit)).upper()}"
                             for p, u, path, hit in rows)
    conn.query(f"""INSERT INTO {_t('WORKSHOP_GENERATION_AUDIT')}
        (PARTNER_NAME, USE_CASE_ID, PATH, CACHE_HIT) {sel}""", ttl=0)
```

Note: `conn.query` on DDL/INSERT matches how `utils/judge_cache.py` already writes (check `judge_cache.ensure_table`/`batch_insert` use the same call; if they use `conn.session().sql(...).collect()`, use that form here instead, identically).

```python
"""Per-use-case workshop generation. Output dict has identical keys on every path."""
import json
import re
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

from . import assets, cache, prompts
from .compliance import find_violations, scrub
from .context import fetch_uc_context
from .gate import fetch_a360_context, is_listed, load_listed_names

MODEL = "claude-sonnet-4-5"
MAX_WORKERS = 32
_FENCE = re.compile(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", re.M)


def recipe_band(conf: int) -> str:
    return "full" if conf > 80 else ("reference" if conf >= 50 else "none")


def _parse(raw: str) -> dict:
    s = _FENCE.sub("", raw or "").strip()
    start, end = s.find("{"), s.rfind("}")
    return json.loads(s[start:end + 1]) if start >= 0 else {}


def _clean(value, allow):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return scrub(value, allow)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [v for v in (_clean(x, allow) for x in value) if v not in ("", [], {})]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _clean(v, allow) if k != "sql" else value[k] for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def _call_json(llm, prompt, validate):
    """One call + one regeneration if the result fails validation or still leaks."""
    for _ in range(2):
        try:
            data = _parse(llm(prompt))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if validate(data) and not find_violations(json.dumps(data)):
            return data
    return None


def _fallback_session1(uc):
    skill = (uc["skills"] or ["cortex-code"])[0]
    return [
        {"title": "Discover the data", "purpose": "Find the objects this use case needs.",
         "prompt": f"List the databases, schemas and tables relevant to: {uc['name']}. Summarize what each contains."},
        {"title": f"Build with {skill}", "purpose": "Create a first working version together.",
         "prompt": f"Using the {skill} skill, build a first version of {uc['name']} on the tables identified above."},
        {"title": "Extend and operationalize", "purpose": "Plan the path to production.",
         "prompt": f"Review what we built for {uc['name']} and propose tests, scheduling and access controls."},
    ]


def build_one(uc, partner, account_signals, private_context, llm) -> dict:
    allow = assets.link_allowlist()
    s1 = _call_json(llm, prompts.session1_prompt(uc, partner, account_signals),
                    lambda d: len(d.get("prompts", [])) == 3)
    session1 = _clean(s1["prompts"], allow) if s1 else _fallback_session1(uc)

    rm = _call_json(llm, prompts.recipe_match_prompt(uc),
                    lambda d: assets.recipe_meta(d.get("recipe_id", "")) != {})
    recipe = {"band": "none"}
    if rm:
        conf = max(0, min(100, int(rm.get("confidence", 0))))
        band = recipe_band(conf)
        if band != "none":
            meta = assets.recipe_meta(rm["recipe_id"])
            recipe = {"band": band, "id": meta["id"], "title": meta["title"], "confidence": conf,
                      "rationale": scrub(rm.get("rationale", ""), allow),
                      "body": assets.recipe_body(meta["id"]) if band == "full" else ""}

    plan_recipe = {k: recipe[k] for k in ("id", "title") if k in recipe} or None
    s2 = _call_json(llm, prompts.session2_prompt(uc, partner, private_context, plan_recipe),
                    lambda d: bool(d.get("steps")))
    plan = _clean(s2, allow) if s2 else {}
    brief = plan.get("problem_statement") or scrub(uc.get("sanitized_desc", ""), allow)
    return {"uc_id": uc["uc_id"], "account": uc["account"], "name": uc["name"], "skills": uc["skills"],
            "brief": brief, "session1": session1, "session2": {"recipe": recipe, "plan": plan}}


def generate_workshops(conn, rows: list, partner: str, complete_fn, call_log=None, log_wrap=None) -> list:
    """rows: gap-table rows already filtered to not-deployed. complete_fn(conn, model, prompt) -> str.
    log_wrap(call_log, label, use_case, fn, *args) is the page's _logged_rest_call (optional)."""
    if not rows:
        return []
    cache.ensure_tables(conn)
    listed = load_listed_names(conn)
    listed_accounts = [r["account"] for r in rows if is_listed(r["account"], listed)]
    a360 = fetch_a360_context(conn, listed_accounts)
    sfdc = fetch_uc_context(conn, [r["uc_id"] for r in rows])
    version = assets.asset_version()

    jobs = []
    for r in rows:
        listed_flag = is_listed(r["account"], listed)
        signals = a360.get((r["account"] or "").upper()) if listed_flag else None
        ctx = sfdc.get(r["uc_id"], {})
        key = cache.compute_hash({"uc": {k: r.get(k) for k in ("uc_id", "name", "account", "skills", "sanitized_desc")},
                                  "partner": partner, "signals": signals, "ctx": ctx}, version)
        jobs.append((r, signals, ctx, key, "listed" if listed_flag else "unlisted"))

    hits = cache.lookup(conn, [j[3] for j in jobs])

    def _run(job):
        r, signals, ctx, key, _ = job
        if key in hits:
            return hits[key]

        def llm(prompt):
            if log_wrap and call_log is not None:
                return log_wrap(call_log, "workshop", r["name"], complete_fn, conn, MODEL, prompt)
            return complete_fn(conn, MODEL, prompt)
        return build_one(r, partner, signals, ctx, llm)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS) as ex:
        results = list(ex.map(_run, jobs))

    cache.insert(conn, [(j[3], partner, j[0]["uc_id"], res) for j, res in zip(jobs, results) if j[3] not in hits],
                 asset_version=version)
    cache.audit(conn, [(partner, j[0]["uc_id"], j[4], j[3] in hits) for j in jobs])
    return results
```

```python
import html

SCOPE_NOTE = ("The summary above reflects all use cases in the selected period. The sections that follow "
              "focus only on use cases not yet in production — each with a ready-to-run workshop plan for "
              "the partner and Snowflake to co-build with the customer.")

_h = lambda s: html.escape(str(s or ""))


def scope_note_html() -> str:
    return (f'<div style="border-left:3px solid #29b5e8;background:#f0f9ff;padding:10px 14px;'
            f'font-size:12.5px;color:#0f172a;margin:22px 0 6px;">{_h(SCOPE_NOTE)}</div>')


def _md_block(text):
    return f'<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11.5px;background:#f8fafc;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;">{_h(text)}</pre>'


def _session1(items):
    return "".join(f'<div style="margin:0 0 12px;"><b>{i}. {_h(p["title"])}</b>'
                   f'<div style="color:#6b7280;font-size:12px;">{_h(p["purpose"])}</div>{_md_block(p["prompt"])}</div>'
                   for i, p in enumerate(items, 1))


def _session2(s2):
    rec, plan = s2.get("recipe", {}), s2.get("plan", {})
    out = ""
    if rec.get("band") == "full":
        out += (f'<h4 style="margin:0 0 6px;">Recommended recipe: {_h(rec["title"])} '
                f'<span style="background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 8px;font-size:11px;">'
                f'{rec["confidence"]}% match</span></h4><p style="font-size:12px;">{_h(rec["rationale"])}</p>'
                f'{_md_block(rec["body"])}')
    elif rec.get("band") == "reference":
        out += f'<p style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;">Closest recipe: {_h(rec["title"])} · {rec["confidence"]}% — reference</p>'
    out += '<h4 style="margin:14px 0 6px;">Implementation plan</h4>'
    if plan.get("architecture"):
        out += "<b>Architecture</b><ul>" + "".join(f"<li>{_h(a)}</li>" for a in plan["architecture"]) + "</ul>"
    for i, s in enumerate(plan.get("steps", []), 1):
        out += f'<div style="margin:8px 0;"><b>Step {i}: {_h(s.get("title"))}</b><div style="font-size:12px;">{_h(s.get("detail"))}</div>'
        out += (_md_block(s["sql"]) if s.get("sql") else "") + "</div>"
    if plan.get("coco_prompts"):
        out += "<b>CoCo prompts</b>" + "".join(_md_block(p) for p in plan["coco_prompts"])
    if plan.get("considerations"):
        out += "<b>Considerations</b><ul>" + "".join(f"<li>{_h(c)}</li>" for c in plan["considerations"]) + "</ul>"
    if plan.get("docs"):
        out += "<b>Resources</b><ul>" + "".join(
            f'<li><a href="{_h(d.get("url"))}">{_h(d.get("title"))}</a></li>' for d in plan["docs"]) + "</ul>"
    return out


def render_workshop_html(workshops: list) -> str:
    if not workshops:
        return ""
    css = [".ws-pane,.ws-sec{display:none}",
           ".ws-side label{display:block;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#374151}",
           ".ws-tabs label{display:inline-block;padding:6px 12px;margin-right:4px;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px}",
           ".ws input{display:none}"]
    radios, side, panes = "", "", ""
    for i, w in enumerate(workshops):
        radios += f'<input type="radio" name="ws-uc" id="ws-uc-{i}"{" checked" if i == 0 else ""}>'
        side += f'<label for="ws-uc-{i}"><b>{_h(w["account"])}</b><br>{_h(w["name"])}</label>'
        css.append(f"#ws-uc-{i}:checked~.ws-body .ws-p{i}{{display:block}}")
        css.append(f"#ws-uc-{i}:checked~.ws-body .ws-side label[for=ws-uc-{i}]{{background:#e0f2fe;color:#0c4a6e}}")
        tabs = "".join(f'<input type="radio" name="ws-t-{i}" id="ws-t-{i}-{k}"{" checked" if k == "a" else ""}>'
                       for k in "abc")
        bar = "".join(f'<label for="ws-t-{i}-{k}">{n}</label>' for k, n in zip("abc", ("Brief", "Session 1", "Session 2")))
        for k in "abc":
            css.append(f"#ws-t-{i}-{k}:checked~.ws-s{k}{{display:block}}")
            css.append(f"#ws-t-{i}-{k}:checked~.ws-tabs label[for=ws-t-{i}-{k}]{{border-bottom-color:#29b5e8;font-weight:700}}")
        skills = ", ".join(_h(s) for s in w["skills"])
        panes += (f'<div class="ws-pane ws-p{i}">{tabs}<div class="ws-tabs" style="border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;margin-bottom:12px;">{bar}</div>'
                  f'<div class="ws-sec ws-sa"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;">{_h(w["name"])}</h3>'
                  f'<p style="font-size:12.5px;">{_h(w["brief"])}</p><p style="font-size:12px;"><b>Proposed CoCo skills:</b> {skills}</p></div>'
                  f'<div class="ws-sec ws-sb"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;">Session 1 — Get started with CoCo</h3>{_session1(w["session1"])}</div>'
                  f'<div class="ws-sec ws-sc"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;">Session 2 — Co-build</h3>{_session2(w["session2"])}</div></div>')
    return (f'<style>{"".join(css)}</style>'
            f'<div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#0f172a;margin:26px 0 8px;">Workshop Plans</div>'
            f'<div class="ws">{radios}<div class="ws-body" style="display:flex;gap:14px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;">'
            f'<div class="ws-side" style="flex:0 0 220px;border-right:1px solid #f1f5f9;padding-right:8px;">{side}</div>'
            f'<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">{panes}</div></div></div>')
```

Note: the `.ws-side` and panes must be descendants of `.ws-body`, which is a later sibling of the radios — the selectors above (`#ws-uc-i:checked~.ws-body ...`) rely on that order; keep it.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `utils/workshop/render_pdf.py`:

```python
import html

from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.platypus import PageBreak, Paragraph, Preformatted, Spacer, Table, TableStyle

from .render_html import SCOPE_NOTE

_e = lambda s: html.escape(str(s or ""))


def _code(text, styles):
    st = ParagraphStyle("wsCode", parent=styles["cell"], fontName="Courier", fontSize=7.5, leading=9.5)
    return Preformatted(str(text or "")[:6000], st, maxLineLength=110)


def scope_note_flowable(styles):
    t = Table([[Paragraph(_e(SCOPE_NOTE), styles["body"])]], colWidths=[7.3 * 72])
    t.setStyle(TableStyle([("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, -1), HexColor("#F0F9FF")),
                           ("LINEBEFORE", (0, 0), (0, -1), 3, HexColor("#29B5E8")),
                           ("LEFTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8), ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),
                           ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6)]))
    return t


def workshop_pdf_flowables(workshops, styles) -> list:
    out = []
    h2, body = styles["heading2"], styles["body"]
    for w in workshops:
        out.append(PageBreak())
        out.append(Paragraph(f"{_e(w['account'])} &middot; {_e(w['name'])}", h2))
        out.append(Paragraph(_e(w["brief"]), body))
        out.append(Paragraph(f"<b>Proposed CoCo skills:</b> {_e(', '.join(w['skills']))}", body))
        out.append(Spacer(1, 8))
        out.append(Paragraph("Session 1 &mdash; Get started with CoCo", h2))
        for i, p in enumerate(w["session1"], 1):
            out.append(Paragraph(f"<b>{i}. {_e(p['title'])}</b> &mdash; {_e(p['purpose'])}", body))
            out.append(_code(p["prompt"], styles))
        out.append(Paragraph("Session 2 &mdash; Co-build", h2))
        rec, plan = w["session2"].get("recipe", {}), w["session2"].get("plan", {})
        if rec.get("band") == "full":
            out.append(Paragraph(f"<b>Recommended recipe:</b> {_e(rec['title'])} ({rec['confidence']}% match). "
                                 f"{_e(rec['rationale'])}", body))
            out.append(_code(rec["body"], styles))
        elif rec.get("band") == "reference":
            out.append(Paragraph(f"Closest recipe: {_e(rec['title'])} &middot; {rec['confidence']}% &mdash; reference", body))
        out.append(Paragraph("<b>Implementation plan</b>", body))
        for a in plan.get("architecture", []):
            out.append(Paragraph(f"&bull; {_e(a)}", body))
        for i, s in enumerate(plan.get("steps", []), 1):
            out.append(Paragraph(f"<b>Step {i}: {_e(s.get('title'))}</b> {_e(s.get('detail'))}", body))
            if s.get("sql"):
                out.append(_code(s["sql"], styles))
        for p in plan.get("coco_prompts", []):
            out.append(_code(p, styles))
        for c in plan.get("considerations", []):
            out.append(Paragraph(f"&bull; {_e(c)}", body))
        for d in plan.get("docs", []):
            out.append(Paragraph(f'<link href="{_e(d.get("url"))}">{_e(d.get("title"))}</link>', body))
    return out
```
